chapters.label: Stamford Bridge
chapters.text: Stamford Bridge, 2005: Barcelona are losing to Chelsea. Ronaldinho gets the ball twenty yards out, four blue shirts around him. Then... goal!

chapters.label: The shimmy
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He pretends to shoot, twice, and his hips sway left and right. The defenders freeze, like someone pressed pause!

chapters.label: Toe-poke
chapters.text: From behind: no big backswing. He pokes it with his toe, past a stunned Petr Čech.

chapters.label: Freeze them
chapters.text: A small body feint freezes defenders, and you can score without a big backswing. A quick toe-poke surprises the keeper.
